Definition
[Ray-space distance] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0513 ↗ def:chow-iii-i51-ray-equivalence 1. appi:eq-1.62\group Points at infinity

Whenever the limit exists, define \[ d_R([\alpha ],[\beta ])=lim_{s\to \infty } \frac{\dhat _{S(p,s)}(\alpha \cap S(p,s),\beta \cap S(p,s))}{s}. \]
